# test Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    test = {
      source  = "speakeasy/test"
      version = "0.0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "test" {
  server_url = "..." # Optional
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to https://api.example.com)
